major_projects.name: Intelligent Traffic Violation Detection Platform
major_projects.description:
A comprehensive traffic monitoring solution that combines computer vision and OCR technologies to detect vehicles, capture license plates, measure speeds, and automate violation alerts. The system provides intelligent traffic management with detailed logging and violation tracking.

**Challenge:**
Traditional traffic monitoring requires manual observation and is prone to human error. Law enforcement agencies needed an automated system for accurate speed detection, license plate recognition, and violation documentation.

**Solution:**
Developed an AI-powered traffic monitoring platform that automatically detects vehicles, measures speeds, captures license plates, and generates violation alerts(if the vehicle exceeds speed limit) with comprehensive logging.

**Technical Architecture:**
- **Object Detection:** YOLO for real-time vehicle detection and classification
- **Computer Vision:** OpenCV for video processing and speed calculation
- **Deep Learning:** PyTorch for custom model training and optimization
- **OCR Technology:** Advanced optical character recognition for license plate reading
- **Data Processing:** NumPy and Pandas for efficient data manipulation
- **Tracking Algorithm:** Custom vehicle tracking for consistent identification
- **Alert System:** Real-time notification system for speed violations

**Innovative Features:**
- Real-time vehicle detection and classification (cars, trucks, motorcycles)
- Accurate speed measurement using advanced tracking algorithms
- License plate detection and OCR with high accuracy rates
- Intelligent vehicle tracking across multiple camera frames
- Automated violation alert system with configurable speed thresholds
- Comprehensive logging system with vehicle IDs, timestamps, and speeds
- Structured data export for law enforcement integration
- Multi-lane traffic monitoring capabilities
- Weather and lighting condition adaptability

**System Capabilities:**
- Process multiple vehicle streams simultaneously
- Generate detailed violation reports with evidence (images, videos) and send the email to the admin/security head
- Integration capability with existing traffic management systems
- Real-time dashboard for traffic monitoring personnel
- Historical data analysis for traffic pattern insights
- Configurable violation parameters per location/zone

major_projects.name: Face Recognition Attendance System
major_projects.Project_type: Company Project - Developed when working as Junior Developer at PayGURU Technosoft Pvt. Ltd.
major_projects.description:
A sophisticated real-time face recognition attendance and authentication system using  multi-face detection capabilities and dynamic tracking. The system integrates with existing CCTV infrastructure for seamless operation, revolutionising the traditional Attendance taking methods .

**Problem Statement:**
Traditional attendance systems require manual interaction and can be prone to buddy punching. Organizations needed an automated, contactless solution that could integrate with existing security infrastructure.

**Solution:**
Developed an AI-powered attendance system that automatically detects and recognizes faces from CCTV feeds, triggers attendance logging, and integrates with access control systems for door unlocking.

**Technical Implementation:**
- **Computer Vision:** YOLO for real-time face detection with high accuracy
- **Face Recognition:** Dlib for robust face encoding and matching
- **Deep Learning:** Custom neural networks for improved recognition accuracy
- **Video Processing:** OpenCV for real-time video stream processing
- **UI Framework:** PyQt5 for professional desktop application interface
- **Camera Integration:** RTSP protocol for CCTV camera connectivity
- **Database:** MySQL for storing face encodings and attendance records
- **Hardware Integration:** Automatic biometric device triggering

**Advanced Features:**
- Multi-face detection and tracking in real-time video streams
- Dynamic face tracking across multiple camera angles
- Integration with existing CCTV infrastructure via RTSP
- Automatic biometric punch-in triggering upon recognition
- Door access control integration with automatic unlocking
- Real-time attendance logging with timestamp accuracy
- Comprehensive attendance record management
- Face encoding database with efficient matching algorithms

**Performance Achievements:**
- Real-time processing at 30+ FPS with multiple face detection
- 80%+ face recognition accuracy under various lighting conditions
- Sub-second response time for attendance logging
- Seamless integration with existing security infrastructure
- Zero-touch attendance marking improving hygiene and efficiency
- Reduced attendance fraud and improved accuracy

other_projects.name: Expense Tracker Mobile App
other_projects.content:

Built this app to learn mobile development with Flutter while solving a personal need for expense tracking. The project served as a practical introduction to mobile app development, Firebase integration, and cross-platform development.

**Technical Implementation:**
- **Framework:** Flutter for cross-platform mobile development
- **Language:** Dart for application logic and UI development
- **Backend:** Firebase for real-time database and authentication
- **State Management:** Flutter's built-in setState for simple state handling
- **Database:** Cloud Firestore for expense data storage
- **Authentication:** Firebase Auth for user management

**App Features:**
- Comprehensive expense and income tracking
- Category-based expense organization
- Real-time data synchronization across devices
- Visual expense reports and analytics
- Monthly and yearly expense summaries
- Search and filter functionality
- Data backup and restore capabilities
- User-friendly mobile interface

- Gained proficiency in Flutter framework and Dart language
- Learned mobile app development best practices
- Mastered Firebase integration for mobile applications
- Understanding of mobile UI/UX design principles
- Experience with app state management
- Knowledge of mobile app deployment processes

**Technical Skills Developed:**
- Flutter widget system and custom UI components
- Firebase real-time database operations
- Mobile app navigation and routing
- Cross-platform development considerations
- Mobile app performance optimization

other_projects.name: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
other_projects.content:
An interactive educational tool that provides step-by-step visualization of popular sorting algorithms. Built with Python and Pygame to help students and developers understand algorithm mechanics through visual representation.

**Educational Purpose:**
Created this visualizer to bridge the gap between theoretical algorithm knowledge and practical understanding. The tool makes complex sorting algorithms accessible through visual learning.

**Technical Implementation:**
- **Framework:** Pygame for graphics rendering and animations
- **Language:** Python for algorithm implementation and visualization logic
- **Graphics:** Custom drawing routines for array visualization
- **Animation:** Smooth transitions showing algorithm steps
- **Interactivity:** User controls for algorithm selection and speed adjustment

**Implemented Algorithms:**
- **Bubble Sort:** Visual representation of adjacent element swapping
- **Quick Sort:** Partition visualization with pivot selection
- **Merge Sort:** Divide-and-conquer visualization with merging process
- **Insertion Sort:** Step-by-step insertion demonstration
- **Selection Sort:** Minimum element selection visualization

**Key Features:**
- Real-time visualization of sorting process
- Adjustable animation speed for different learning paces
- Color-coded elements to highlight comparisons and swaps
- Algorithm comparison capabilities
- Step-by-step execution with pause/resume functionality
- Performance metrics display (comparisons, swaps, time complexity)
- Educational information panel for each algorithm

**Learning Value:**
- Helps visualize abstract algorithmic concepts
- Demonstrates time complexity differences between algorithms
- Shows algorithm behavior on different data patterns
- Provides hands-on experience with algorithm analysis
- Useful for computer science education and interview preparation
